title: Who is Jesus?
claim_under_test: Jesus of Nazareth was a real first-century Jewish teacher who was crucified, and the earliest Christians proclaimed him risen and Lord; his ultimate identity remains historically and theologically disputed.

current_assessment.summary: The best-supported historical core is Jesus' existence, crucifixion, and early resurrection proclamation. Whether those facts warrant belief that he is God's unique revelation is a further judgment.
current_assessment.certainty_note: Strong on core existence/crucifixion and early proclamation; disputed on source precision and divine identity.

strongest_counterargument: The sources are religious and ancient; natural explanations may account for resurrection belief without a miracle.
what_would_change_the_finding: decisive evidence invalidating the core historical sources
a stronger explanation of the early resurrection proclamation that accounts for the whole record

revision_history.change: Case opened as a separate investigation from the God-existence question.
